text:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout for release v2.3.1 (build 20260320-02). plan: US -> EU -> APAC. canary slices: US 5% -> 25% -> 100%. fallback pinned to v2.3.0. change window: today 18:00-20:00 UTC for global ramp. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 :eyes:

samir: ack, checking capacity dashboards now. quick snapshot: us-west reserved GPU pool at ~65% utilization, us-central ~60%. 5% canary looks fine, can't safely go to 25% without warmup.

lina: noted. Dedicated pools in us-central show 40% headroom but autoscale cooldown is 3m. recommend pre-warm KV cache and run a short synthetic load before bump.

taylor: can run load script now. snippet: ```./tools/loadtest --region us --rps 200 --duration 120``` will simulate the 25% slice. do you want me to start after canary?

ops-oncall: smoke tests running against canary endpoint now. quick log excerpt: ```2026-03-20T18:01:12Z INFO canary-request id=... code=200 latency=72ms
2026-03-20T18:02:05Z WARN gateway proxy 504 retry=1 upstream=timeout
2026-03-20T18:03:01Z INFO canary-request id=... code=200 latency=88ms``` overall green but saw a single 504 from edge gateway during spike. tracking in #eng-oncall.

david: propose rollback/circuit-breaker thresholds: if p95 latency > 400ms OR error rate > 1.0% sustained for 5m, automatic rollback to v2.3.0. command to pin rollback: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/pin -d '{"region":"US","version":"v2.3.0"}'` (ops creds required). also recommend 2-min holdpoint after 5% canary to validate metrics.

release-manager: we will enforce a manual hold between 5% and 25% — release team to confirm metrics and sign off. updating release notes with the rollout matrix and customer impact (none expected). planning APAC handoff at 08:00 UTC tomorrow if all green.

deploy-bot: traffic shift: US -> 5% canary applied at 2026-03-20T18:04:50Z. healthcheck: 20/20 passing, tail latency p95 92ms, errors 0.02%.

samir: saw the deploy-bot update, thanks. request: delay automated ramp to 25% until loadtest completes and we validate eviction/backfill numbers. we had a quota blip last week when we moved too fast.

lina: agree. I'll enable kv-cache warm restart and bump pool min-ready to avoid transient cold misses. starting warm cache seed now.

ops-oncall: monitoring alerts configured: slack -> #eng-oncall, pager if error rate > 1% for 3m. dashboard link: https://dash.internal/d/rollouts/v2.3.1

david: confirming rollback playbook updated and pinned in runbook: https://runbook.internal/rollbacks/v2.3.1. threshold reminders in the runbook and exact curl pins.

release-manager: final: holdpoint set for 30 minutes after canary. if no regressions, ops to proceed with 25% US, then EU 5% canary in parallel. APAC scheduled last to avoid peak overlap. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: noted. automated ramp blocked until release-manager sign-off or explicit `/deploy continue` from release-manager.
